name: Lowcoder
description: A low-code builder for internal tools, dashboards and customer-facing apps: drag components onto a page, wire them to databases and APIs, and publish. The all-in-one image runs the API, the node service, the frontend and its own MongoDB and Redis, all kept on the data volume.

access.note: Lowcoder starts with no account: the first account signed up administers the instance. Open the address yourself right after deploying and sign up before anyone else; sign-up by e-mail can be closed with LOWCODER_EMAIL_SIGNUP_ENABLED in the deployment's variables.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Lowcoder builds links to published apps and invitation e-mails from this address.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The editor, published apps and the API

volumes.name: data
volumes.purpose: The bundled MongoDB and Redis data, logs and uploaded assets

update.notes: Lowcoder migrates its bundled MongoDB on start; back up the data volume before moving to a newer image.

secrets.name: encryption-password
secrets.label: Encryption password
secrets.description: Encrypts stored data-source credentials; changing it makes them unreadable.

secrets.name: encryption-salt
secrets.label: Encryption salt
secrets.description: Salts the encryption of stored data-source credentials.

secrets.name: api-key-secret
secrets.label: API key signing secret
secrets.description: Signs the API keys Lowcoder issues.

secrets.name: node-secret
secrets.label: Node service secret
secrets.description: Authenticates the API to its node service.
